acceptance_gate: The cell theorem and its corollaries are proved in prose, with executable checks of the cell conditions, detour systems, retention, kill probabilities and the topological-minor transfer.
objective: Prove the cell theorem (detour lemma, tangle transfer, degree via the tangle lemma, kill probabilities with bounded-range independence) and its corollaries: plane graphs with short faces pairwise sharing at most one edge, d-dimensional grids, walls, transfer to topological minors by restriction and renaming, and graphs excluding a fixed minor. Check the cell conditions, explicit detour systems and congestion, retention, kill probabilities and the transfer on declared instances.
status: Proved by CELL-SIZE-20261020-001B-P001 (prose, with cited duality and grid-minor theorems): if every edge outside a bounded exceptional set lies on a short cycle with short detours avoiding it, restrictions setting well-separated cycles keep every cut within a factor L+1 (detour lemma), the tangle survives at a 1/(L+1) fraction, and PC/PCR/resolution size of Tseitin is 2^Omega(tangle order). Corollaries: 2-connected plane graphs whose faces pairwise share at most one edge with short inner faces; d-dimensional grids 2^Omega(k^(d-1)); walls; restriction plus renaming to a wall topological minor gives 2^Omega_H(tw) for every graph excluding a fixed minor H (planar included), tight for bounded degree. Checks on declared instances pass; general graphs remain open.
stop_rule: Stop and record the gap if a lemma fails on a checked instance.
title: Proof: Tseitin size from cell systems, with planar and minor-free corollaries
